title: Install parameters for how users sign in to Client Connector

prose.text: These parameters change where and how a user authenticates when Client Connector enrolls them.

prose.label: Machine tunnel.
prose.text: Requiring IdP authentication before a machine tunnel starts is also an install parameter on Windows: [[zpa.machine-tunnels.requirements:machine-auth-install-parameter]].

external-redirect.statement: externalRedirect (MSI `EXTERNALREDIRECT`) enables browser-based authentication on Windows. On macOS it redirects authentication to the organization's SAML IdP through the default browser and Safari; the first time, users must select Remember Me on the IdP login screen, after which the browser logs them in automatically. It defaults to disabled.

quotes: Enables browser-based authentication for Zscaler Client Connector.
Redirects authentication to your organization’s SAML IdP through the default browser and Safari.
When redirected to the browser for the first time, your users must select Remember Me on their IdP log-in screen.

enable-sso.statement: On Windows, enableSSO (MSI `ENABLESSO`) enables SSO with the Windows primary account in an Azure Active Directory environment: 2, the default, follows policy; 1 enables; 0 disables.

quotes: Enables SSO using the Windows Primary account in an Azure Active Directory environment.

install-webview2.statement: installWebView2 (MSI `INSTALLWEBVIEW2`) installs the WebView2 framework, and is meant only for testing WebView2-based functionality on a single device; testing SSO with WebView2 also needs enableSSO.

quotes: Enables installation of the WebView2 framework
This option is used for testing WebView2-based functionality on a single device and should be used for testing only.
You must pass the ENABLESSO or enableSSO option if you want to test SSO with WebView2.

imprivata.statement: On Windows from Client Connector 4.4, enableImprivataIntegration (MSI `ENABLEIMPRIVATAINTEGRATION`) integrates with Imprivata OneSign: Client Connector silently logs the Imprivata OneSign user in, applies security policies and logs the user's activity.

quotes: If enabled, Zscaler Client Connector silently logs in an Imprivata OneSign user to Zscaler Client Connector, applies security policies, and logs the end user activity in Zscaler Client Connector.
This option is available only in Zscaler Client Connector version 4.4 and later for Windows.
